topic: T7_data_future - Data products, search facts, novelty and Sector 110
summary: FINAL: search facts (126,246 stars; BLS after biweight; all 17 LEO-Vetter flux-level tests passed; LEO-Vetter MES 10.597 for 3.18 d and 10.982 for 11.13 d, not SPOC MES; threshold 15 from the ladder rule, examined post hoc; 'fixed before the search' untraceable and correctly absent). Products: TESS-SPOC S6 1800 s PDCSAP, SPOC S32 120 s PDCSAP, QLP S98 200 s SYS_RM_FLUX; every flagged S98 cadence (12,095/24,162) removed. The S98 QLP file is TGLC-era (square 1x1/3x3/5x5 apertures), confirmed live on MAST; the Note should also cite QLP DRN004 (Petitpas et al. 2026, RNAAS 10, 69). Sectors: only 6, 32, 98 and upcoming 110 (cam 1 CCD 2) in tess-point through S134. S110: official orbit table (created today) gives data from 2026-10-31 23:55 UTC and an orbit gap 2026-11-13 19:55-11-14 00:55; the final segment is not yet listed. Counts are ephemeris-independent: 8 or 9 A transit times (9th at 2026-11-26 14:47-14:49 UTC as seen by TESS, not 14:54-14:56; older lists omitted the light-time correction), one of them (Nov 13 ~21:15) inside the gap, and 3 B. The manuscript S110 sentence should add the gap clause. Novelty: all eight named sources logged on 2026-09-25 UTC (latest 11:48Z); sentence stands. M conflicts C031, C039, C042, C089, C093 resolved; C040 cosmetic. Open: final S110 segment times (non-blocking).
